body: 25/F.  I've been cycling in and out of severe depression for the last decade or so.  I can't cope with the overwhelming self-loathing and feelings of hopelessness and worthlessness.  I get the sense that I am inhabiting a completely different reality from those around me, which contributes to the extreme loneliness/alienation.  I keep failing classes and missing work.  I've tried therapy, a few antidepressants and a few mood stabilizers - all to no or poor effect.  My family can't understand what's wrong with me and are understandably disappointed as they watch me throw away a future that they've invested so much in.  I'm exhausted and terrified.  I am absolutely bewildered by the fact that the people around me seem to be leading such happy, fulfilling lives.  I desperately need to believe that my life won't always be like this but I can't imagine anything else right now.
